title: Your styles
lede: Spool listens to your renders and knows the common styles. Teach it yours: every answer refines the styles offered for all your songs.
settingsHint: What Spool hears in your renders, your own styles, and your names for its styles.
notHeard: Your renders have not been listened to yet. The audio analysis does it in the background (Settings > Spool).
agree: Nothing to refine: where Spool clearly hears a style, it agrees with your folders.
keepTip: Every render Spool hears as "{heard}" will count for "{mine}".
dismissTip: Stop offering it. Nothing changes in your styles.
wordsHint: Styles Spool does not know ("neo soul", "jazz fanfare"...). It finds them in folder and file names, like its own.
linksHint: When Spool hears the style on the left, it counts for yours.

banner.one: Spool has a question about the style of {n} song.
banner.other: Spool has questions about the styles of {n} songs.

candidates: Words of your folders that look like styles
candidatesHint: Spool knows the common styles, not necessarily yours. These words come back over several of your songs: tell it whether they are styles, and under which name.
candidateHead: "{word}" comes back in {n} songs, where Spool hears "{heard}"
noTip: Not a style. Spool will not offer it again.
yesTipNamed: Spool will read "{word}" in your folder and file names as this style.
isHeard: This is what Spool hears in these songs.
isNew: A style of yours, new to Spool.
alsoHeard: Elsewhere too, what Spool hears as "{heard}" will count for "{name}" ({n} other songs)

q.head: Spool is unsure about a few songs
q.hint: Confirm in one click: your answer also helps the {n} songs that sound alike.
q.mixedTip: This song mixes several styles. Spool will not ask again.
q.classed: Thanks: "{style}" also helps sort {n} other songs.
q.pause: That's all for now. Spool has a few more questions if you like.
q.none: No more questions for now: Spool will come back when new songs arrive.
